upload.offline: You are offline. Try again when you are back online.
upload.tooLarge: {name} is too large (250 MB at most).
upload.storageNotReady: File storage is not connected yet. Uploads work once Vercel Blob is added.
upload.readOnly: The project is archived; no new files can be added.
upload.failedGeneric: The upload stopped half way. Could you try again?
upload.doneOne: “{name}” uploaded. Claude will suggest where to file it.
upload.doneMany: {count} files uploaded. Claude will suggest where to file them.

title: Files
subtitle: Every file of the project. Claude reads each file you upload and suggests where it goes; nothing moves until you approve.

organize.nothing: Claude found nothing to change in this folder.
organize.working: Claude is reading the files in this folder and proposing an order…

aiOnDone: The folder is open to AI again.
aiOffDone: The folder is closed to AI. Its files are never sent to Claude.
flaggedBanner: {count, plural, one {One file} other {# files}} may hold children's personal data and {count, plural, one {was} other {were}} not sent to AI. Tap to look.
folderCounts: {files, plural, =0 {no files} one {# file} other {# files}}{folders, plural, =0 {} one {, # folder} other {, # folders}}

emptyFolder.title: This folder is empty
emptyFolder.body: Drag files here or upload them. Drag a whole folder and its subfolders come too.

empty.title: No files yet
empty.body: Start with the proposal, agreements, budget and partner reports. You can drag files onto this page; Claude reads each one and suggests its type, period and folder.

drop.title: Drop to upload
drop.body: Files and folders go into this folder.

preview.noneBody: Download it and open it in its own program.
preview.stillReading: The file is still being read. The preview will be here in a few minutes.
preview.readFailed: The text of this file could not be read. If it is a scan, try a clearer copy.
preview.moreRows: Showing the first 300 rows. Download the file for all of it.
preview.textOnly: This is the text read from the file. Download it for the formatted version.

classify.rejected: Suggestion rejected; the file stays as it is.
classify.keyDateTasks: {count, plural, one {Create a task for the coming date} other {Create tasks for the # coming dates}}

doc.indicatorsHint: Claude matches the numbers in the report to your indicators and shows the page of each value. Nothing is saved until you approve.
doc.periodAuto: Leave it empty and Claude finds the period in the file.
doc.classifyDone: Claude prepared a new filing suggestion.

working.extract: Claude is finding the work and dates in the file…
working.indicators: Claude is reading the indicator values…
working.classify: Claude is reading the file again…

hold.title: This file was not sent to AI
hold.body: It may hold children's personal data (names, ID numbers, dates of birth). Search and preview work; Claude does not read it.
hold.cleared: The file is open to AI. Claude will suggest its filing.

doc.summaryPlaceholder: What is this file about? A sentence or two.
doc.keyDateLabel: What happens? For example report due
doc.restored: v{version} is the current version again
doc.viewingVersion: You are looking at an older version (v{version}).

check.title: To check
check.subtitle: Claude's filing suggestions. File them if they are right, otherwise fix or reject them.
check.hint: Each suggestion has a type, folder, partner, period and key dates. Use “Edit” to change any field.
check.allFiled: {count, plural, one {One file filed.} other {# files filed.}}

empty.title: Nothing to check
empty.body: When you upload new files, Claude's suggestions appear here.
empty.noAi: Once AI is connected, Claude will suggest the type, folder and period of each new file. Until then you can organise files yourself.

flaggedEmpty.title: No files on hold
flaggedEmpty.body: Files that may hold children's personal data wait here and are never sent to AI.

check.flaggedHint: These files may hold children's personal data. Claude does not read them. You can upload a version with the personal details removed, check one and open it, or delete it.
